answers.core: I'm not sure an add-on would be able to workaround this, and even if it did, this seems like a fairly simple functionality to not have for this component.
answers.workaround: I have not been able to find any workaround from the scripting level. Creating custom InputEvent or Shortcut classes that hide the inherited method will not have any impact, and there does not seem to be any other property or setting that can be used to adjust this.
